microscopic_source: model.experiments.interval_echo_consensus.sign_graph.PrivateRecordWalk with primitive aperture and default address order
instrument: Hold each single load and expose its private comparison signs for one exchange pi pulse, starting from sharp zero signs. Read all sign addresses. Predict each binary pair cost from the symmetric difference of the two single-load readings. Audit the signed-word predicate separately on 00, 01, 10 and 11. Repeat against a changed law enabling a sign flip when either endpoint is occupied.
release: Start both loads on the launch seam. In the reference preparation every private sign has odd parity. In the second preparation only the comparison signs belonging to the launch seam start sharp zero, with all other signs odd, including all reference signs. Open every material and sign move throughout free release. Retain each final tagged word and all thirty home-seam readings plus quiet. The tagged word is measured in its initial sharp basis. Report the historical 94 percent gate separately for both preparations, allowing failure.
checks: Compare the complete reference generator and terminal laws to the historical pin. Compare the sharp-sign release to a literal sign and material graph on a small carrier. Predict the first nonzero Taylor coefficient of a changed tagged word from independently counted allowed material hops and sign operations. An immediate one-flip amplitude, disagreement of any recorded bin with the lifted walk, or any omitted sector rejects the instrument calculation.
prior_knowledge: The historical persistence target, the passing strengths 8 and 128 and the uniform odd-bank transfer of the private walk were known. The design tests a distinct microscopic source. No sharp launch-bank pair propagation was inspected when these configurations and comparisons were specified.
